about.title: A student interested in boundaries.
paragraphs: I study Computer Science – Artificial Intelligence at Politecnico di Milano. I’m interested in building software that balances solid architecture with intuitive user experiences.
I value small responsibilities, honest trade-offs, reproducible evidence, and interfaces that reveal the underlying model instead of hiding it.
